requirements.requirement: The system must include a credential_completeness_score field in the provider evaluation response payload.
The system must populate credential_completeness_score using the output from the EVAL-CRED-002 scoring logic without modification.
The system must include a credential_completeness_breakdown object containing degrees, licenses, and taxonomy components in the response.
The system must ensure the credential_completeness_score is normalized to the defined range from EVAL-CRED-001 (0-1 or 0-100).
The system must return credential completeness data for every provider evaluation request where NPI data is successfully retrieved.
The system must preserve existing evaluate_care_facade response structure and append credential fields without breaking backward compatibility.
The system must ensure credential completeness fields are serializable and included in API responses returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must log an error and omit credential_completeness_score if the scoring logic dependency (EVAL-CRED-002) fails at runtime.
The system must return a null or explicitly defined fallback value for credential_completeness_score when NPI data is missing or incomplete beyond scoring capability.
The system must ensure that inclusion of credential completeness data does not increase evaluate_care_facade response latency beyond acceptable thresholds defined for provider evaluation.
The system must provide consistent credential completeness values for identical NPI inputs across repeated requests.
The system must expose credential completeness fields in a format consumable by downstream UX and explanation layers without additional transformation.
The system must ensure no personally identifiable information beyond existing NPI-derived fields is introduced in the credential completeness output.
The system must gracefully handle empty credential breakdown components by returning empty arrays or zero values instead of failing the response.
The system must validate that credential_completeness_score is present whenever credential_completeness_breakdown is present in the response.
